post.summary: Put a note on the family board

schema.description: Makes the call safe to repeat (1-100 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `-`). The same key for the same action returns the first result without running it again (response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); for another action it is refused with 422. Keys are kept 7 days.

parameters.description: Makes the call safe to repeat (1-100 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `-`). The same key for the same action returns the first result without running it again (response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); for another action it is refused with 422. Keys are kept 7 days.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

text.description: The note, in the family's own words (at most 500 characters); line breaks are kept

paper.description: The color of the paper, note-1 … note-5

pinned.description: Keeps the note at the top; only people who manage the board can; leave it out

endsOn.description: The last day the note stays on the board (YYYY-MM-DD, family time); leave out to keep it
